content.title: Robust Ethics: The Metaphysics and Epistemology of Godless Normative Realism
content.author: Erik J. Wielenberg (Oxford University Press, 2014)
content.note: The strongest recent case that objective moral facts exist without God, as brute ethical facts. Cited as the critic's own case. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
